name: UX/UI, design process
description:
I have been professionally involved in design since 1997.

I have come a long way from being a technical designer in print media to becoming a Senior Product Designer. I realized that design is about solving problems, and I really enjoy working in this field.

In recent years, I have been working on complex projects. I have developed AR interface standards for ground equipment at NATO STO. I have worked with artificial intelligence and computer vision systems. The systems I have been involved in developing have helped large enterprises improve personnel safety and security.

How can I be helpful?
I have extensive experience in organizing and standardizing design, including designing systems and information architecture. I have a great passion for my team, and I am skilled at managing and motivating colleagues. I would be happy to assist you as well.

For me, design is always a dialogue. If you need to discuss ideas or talk about your decisions, I will be glad to help. Regardless of your level, experience, or the complexity of your request, I am confident that our communication will be pleasant and productive.
author: Sasha Howell
